Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Surgical Oncology)

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria (Post-Wise Summary)
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university, with 2 years’ experience in testing/evaluation of agricultural machinery, or 2 years’ teaching/training experience in operation/maintenance of tractors and agricultural implements. Age limit: 33 years (OBC). Qualification: Degree in Unani Medicine from a recognized university/board recognized under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970, with enrolment on the Central/State Register of Indian Medicine. Age limit: 35 years (UR/EWS), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC). Qualification: Master’s Degree in the respective discipline from a recognized university, with 3 years’ research experience after acquiring the essential qualification. PhD and lab experience in conservation/non-destructive testing are desirable. Age limit: 35 years (UR), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC). Qualification: Recognized MBBS degree with completion of compulsory rotating internship. Post-graduate medical qualification is desirable. Age limit: 35 years (UR/EWS), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC/ST). Qualification: MBBS with a postgraduate degree/diploma (MD/DNB) in Immunology, Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion, Pathology, Bacteriology or Haematology with relevant special training, plus at least 3 years’ teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Registrar/Assistant Professor. Age limit: 40 years (UR), 43 years (OBC). Qualification: MBBS with a postgraduate degree/diploma in Surgical Oncology or General Surgery/ENT/Orthopaedics/Obst. & Gynae with special training in Surgical Oncology, plus at least 3 years’ teaching experience. Age limit: 43 years (OBC). Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Chemical/Metallurgical/Electronics & Communication Engineering, with 3 years’ experience in steel works/rolling mills/plant machinery manufacturing or in iron & steel production, planning, development and research. Age limit: 35 years (UR). Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science, registered with the Veterinary Council of India or a State/UT Veterinary Council. Knowledge of Tamil, Malayalam or Telugu is an advantage. Age limit: 35 years (UR), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC). Note: Age relaxation of up to 10 years is available for PwBD candidates, up to 5 years for SC/ST and up to 3 years for OBC as applicable, and other relaxations for Ex-Servicemen and Central/UT Government employees apply as per UPSC rules.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to these posts is made through Recruitment Test (RT), wherever applicable, followed by an Interview, or by Interview alone. The minimum level of suitability in the interview is 50 marks for UR, 45 marks for OBC, and 40 marks for SC/ST/PwBD candidates out of 100 total marks. Candidates must meet the minimum suitability criteria at both the RT and Interview stages, wherever an RT is conducted.

faq.question: Q1. What is UPSC Advertisement No. 09/2026?
faq.answer: It is an Indicative Advertisement issued by the Union Public Service Commission inviting online applications for Direct Recruitment by Selection to 40 vacancies across 12 different posts in various government departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are there in UPSC Advt No. 09/2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 40 vacancies spread across posts such as Agricultural Engineer, Medical Officer/Research Officer (Unani), Scientist 'B', Civilian Medical Officer, Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor, Assistant Industrial Adviser, and Veterinary Assistant Surgeon.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPSC Recruitment 2026 (Advt 09/2026)?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14th August 2026. Applications opened on 25th July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this UPSC recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online only through the official website upsconline.nic.in/ora. No offline applications are accepted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these UPSC posts?
faq.answer: These posts are filled through Direct Recruitment by Selection, generally involving shortlisting and an interview, as per UPSC's standard recruitment process.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for posts under Advt No. 09/2026?
faq.answer: Pay scales range from Level-07 to Level-11 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th CPC, with some posts also carrying Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA).

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for PwBD candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the age limit is further relaxable by up to 10 years for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) candidates for vacancies identified as suitable or reserved for them.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates find the detailed advertisement for these posts?
faq.answer: The detailed recruitment advertisement, along with instructions and additional information for candidates, is available on the UPSC website at upsc.gov.in and upsconline.nic.in/ora.
